description: This file defines a generic handler for container file API endpoints within the LiteLLM framework. It provides both synchronous and asynchronous methods to interact with container-related API endpoints specified in 'endpoints.json', handling URL construction, request sending, response parsing, and error handling. The class 'GenericContainerHandler' centralizes container file API request logic for the project.
